output.text: When tackling the Box Garden puzzle, start by placing the long block first along the bottom edge—this sets a stable foundation and defines the primary axis of your layout. Next, reserve the corner pocket for a triangular piece; this strategic placement ensures that the irregular shape fits snugly without blocking access to other critical areas. Finally, remember to rotate the small square before filling the central gap—this small adjustment often unlocks the correct alignment needed to complete the puzzle efficiently. By following this sequence, you’ll transform a seemingly chaotic arrangement into a coherent, solvable structure.
